issues.problem: Quote submission uses browser native alert() dialog on quote.html instead of inline success card
issues.customer_impact: Looks unprofessional, causes browser blocking, high abandonment rate after submit
issues.recommended_fix: Replace alert() with seamless in-page confirmation card showing reference number and next steps

issues.problem: No persistent mobile contact/action bar (Call / WhatsApp / Quote)
issues.customer_impact: Mobile visitors have to scroll extensively to reach phone number or quote trigger
issues.recommended_fix: Implement non-intrusive sticky bottom action bar for mobile devices

top_cta_variations: Check My Vehicle & Tell Us What It's Doing
Get a Quote for Your Vehicle
Request a Quote for Your Vehicle
Check My Automatic Vehicle & Get Quote

journeys.journey: Journey A: Google -> General Gearbox Repair (/services/gearbox-repair)
journeys.intent: My gearbox has a problem and I need someone to repair it.
findings: Hero has technical jargon above fold ('Hydraulic mechatronic diagnostics & mechanical teardown')
CTA text varies ('Quote Me ->', 'Request Repair Estimate', 'Book Diagnostic')
No sticky mobile action bar for quick Call/WhatsApp on mobile viewports
Quote form opens modal rather than smooth inline transition with pre-filled service context

journeys.intent: I need an automatic gearbox specialist.
findings: Deep engineering descriptions of planetary gearsets before reassuring customer about repair process
Warranty details are buried in deep section rather than visible trust strip
Mobile CTA requires 3 full screen scrolls to reach

journeys.intent: My DSG is faulty / juddering / showing warnings.
findings: Good technical accuracy underneath, but lacks plain-English symptom cards at top
Does not clearly link directly into relevant fault symptoms (e.g., /faults/dsg-juddering)
CTA is generic 'Quote Me' instead of 'Check My DSG Gearbox'
Good progressive disclosure structure (notice, urgency, action, causes)
Lacks standardized 'Get My Gearbox Checked' CTA at end of diagnosis journey
Mobile tap targets for related symptom navigation are under 44px

journeys.intent: Visitor does not know anything about transmissions.
findings: Interactive wizard exists but lacks 5 clear visual symptom card groupings on first screen
Requires multi-step input before showing plain-English symptom possibilities
Mobile scroll depth is high on 375px screens

journeys.intent: I think I have DSG/Powershift/CVT but I'm not sure.
findings: Acts more like a directory than an intuitive vehicle/transmission explorer
Lacks prominent 'Not sure which gearbox you have? Enter Reg' helper section at top
CTAs on gearbox family cards are inconsistent

journeys.intent: Can you repair/collect my car in Harrow?
findings: Explanation of vehicle collection coverage is clear and compliant
Lacks persistent mobile contact bar for instant local phone calls
Map embed is static image; quote CTA button below map is small on mobile

journeys.intent: Customer wants immediate help & price estimate.
findings: Form submission on quote.html triggers JavaScript alert() rather than in-page confirmation
Form does not show clear 3-step progress (1. Vehicle, 2. Problem, 3. Contact)
Manual fallback dropdowns are shown simultaneously, adding visual clutter
